plain: A person who rises in revolt against a government.

webster.text: A person who rises in opposition to civil or political authority; one who openly and actively resists the execution of laws.

example.quote: I believe a great majority of the insurgents were drawn into it by false artifices.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. IREDELL, July 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
